fields.title: 📖 The Ottomans ≠ the Khilāfah of the Nubuwwah
fields.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ, an-Nawawī, and al-ʿAynī** said:

> ***“The Khilāfah of the Nubuwwah lasts thirty years; thereafter Allah gives kingship to whom He wills.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Not every great Muslim state is automatically Khilāfah an-Nubuwwah. The texts distinguish between Khilāfah and Mulk, and they bind the Imāmah Kubrā in principle to Quraysh.

immutable.source: 📝 Abū Dāwūd, as-Sunan, Kitāb as-Sunnah, Bāb fī al-Khulafāʾ, Hadith Nr. 4646; an-Nawawī, Sharḥ Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim, Kitāb al-Imārah; al-ʿAynī, ʿUmdat al-Qārī, Kitāb al-Aḥkām.
